candidate_name: LLM-SE 显式句级模态候选

policy.candidate_name: LLM-SE 显式句级模态候选
policy.scope: single test-informed exploratory candidate; no dev run; historical 22-shot control
policy.primary_metric: four-class macro_f1 over all 426 test samples
policy.diagnostic_readout: unchanged llm_se.extract_modality_label on the same response's rule_record
policy.canonical_validation_policy: Call existing validate_canonical on a private copy. Report structural/span failures separately; do not gate sentence scores on six-element span correctness. No rewriting or repair. Malformed envelope or source binding invalidates both readouts; invalid sentence fields invalidate primary only. This is disclosed interface/readout change, not a historical rescore.
policy.missing_prediction_policy: Null, invalid sentence evidence/fields, parse failure, request failure and not-issued samples remain in all-426 denominator as None; no class fallback.
future_execution_requirements: New explicit user authorization must bind this suite, the delivered preflight SHA-256, request count, price table, model, cap and zero retries. Historical authorizations are inapplicable.
Revalidate frozen sources, data, request bodies and returned model before scoring; no implicit use of .env.

Reserve input wire byte bound plus 1024 tokens and full 4096 output tokens before each send, charging all input as cache miss. Stop before spent + unsettled + in-flight reservation + next reservation exceeds cap.
Write started and finished append-only events, request/response hashes, usage, model and timestamps. Never repeat a started ID, including uncertain transport outcomes.

Transport, model, request-byte or usage/accounting failures stop new sends and drain in-flight responses. No automatic retry. Parse/null failures remain None. Unissued IDs also remain None in partial-run diagnostics; do not call a partial run completed.
Stop outside off-peak or at cap. Reconfirm changed price/model, budget expansion or a new retry batch explicitly; never silently switch model or sampling.
predeclared_reporting: all-sample accuracy and macro P/R/F1; four-class P/R/F1 and confusion matrix
corrected/regressed versus historical 22-shot, prohibition TP/FP/FN and no-prediction counts
same-response first-clause diagnostic and per-ID differences from explicit sentence label
raw response/identity/canonical validation counts, costs, failures and incomplete run status
policy.decision_policy: Report all predeclared comparisons regardless of outcome. No promise to fix all 33 errors, no automatic promotion, no post-run replacement of primary metric. Existing dev/test have informed design; future scores remain exploratory.

isolation.near_rule: same prepare_sun_modality_eligibility_shots_v1.near_match; token ratio >= .80, contiguous >= .85 of shorter >= 8 tokens, or character ratio >= .88
isolation.retained_18_near_check: not newly claimed; same exact/normalized isolation as parent

budget_estimate.method: UTF-8 JSON bytes / 3 rounded up; no tokenizer, all cache miss, 22-shot mean completion + 256 new-envelope tokens
budget_estimate.note: Estimate is not a charge or upper bound. Cap is only a proposal; a future run stops before exceeding it even if fewer than 426 are issued.
